description: A yellow tabletop is in front of a white fabric backdrop, with a light blue cloth on the surface and a small spray bottle to the right. The left hand presses the blue cloth against the tabletop and wipes back and forth in short strokes near the back edge, while the right hand holds the spray bottle nearby and briefly tilts it downward as if to spray, then returns upright; the cloth is the left-hand object and the bottle is the right-hand object.
